MA.note: Direct CSV, no auth. 15 CSVs total in their open data catalog (also sales data).

NY.note: Socrata API, real-time. Types include retail, cultivator, processor, distributor, microbusiness.

CO.note: Cultivations sheet (MED). Also retail/other sheets exist on the MED licensee page.

blocked_or_js.CA: DCC search tool is a JS app; data.ca.gov has no DCC bulk dataset indexed
blocked_or_js.strain-database.com: Cloudflare managed turnstile (unrelated to licenses but same blocker)

notes: MA + NY + CO = ~4,100 license records immediately ingestable
NY license types directly map to our needs: cultivator/processor/distributor/dispensary
MA has EIN + owner contact info
Apify has a 'Cannabis License National Aggregator' scraper (paid) that aggregates many states — fallback for CA/MI
